title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words — Episode8 Let Me Support You

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Line: Later that night
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you...!
I'll bring the tickets over later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure.
I promise to practice to make sure you get to see a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? You'll ask your friends...?
That'd be great! Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, sure... I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
That's a few more off our hands.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Dad said that he'd ask around too.
At this rate, Shiho and I should just barely make it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure she feels some sense of relief too...
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you sold three already?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did! I asked someone I know and told them about how I'm in a band with my childhood friends. They seemed really interested and decided to buy a few.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That leaves twelve.
It's a lot, but I think we can do it as long as we share the load...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. Thanks, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You don't need to thank me. All I did was make a few calls.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still can't believe that you sold fifteen out of thirty all on your own, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know a lot of musicians so I asked the ones who I thought would be most interested first.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What about Shizuku and your family?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She'd treat it like some sort of idol concert, so that's sort of a last resort...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Also, I'm really sorry.
I can tell that you'd rather tell Ichika and Saki about this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I would and it does bother me a little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's better than letting you go through this on your own.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe...
This time, it'll be our little secret.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But starting next time, let's do this all together, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. I'll make sure things go smoother then.
A few days later
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially considering how much effort we put into our new song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. It wasn't easy, but I'm glad we made it in time for this show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? Sometimes it felt like we'd never finish...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You would've finished eventually.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you all did a great job getting it done...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nice work, Ichika, Saki.
You too, Honami. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I didn't do anything...
I should be the one thanking you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, the usual?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Take it away, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's make sure our new song reaches and moves everyone who came to see us today...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Okay, this is good...
Each verse has more depth to it and Ichika's making that clear through her singing.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's synth is really shining right before the chorus too. Honami was right about holding back on the drums there.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And that's followed up by Honami's drum fill...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Perfect...
Ichika hit that high note right in time with that fill.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
This song's pretty good.
It's like it was made to cheer people up, you know?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, they've really upped their game too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The crowd seems to like it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And no mistakes as far as I can tell. They're playing like they really mean it. All that practice is really paying off...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was awesome!
And so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It really was...!
Everyone in the audience really seemed to like it too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Seemed?
They did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of the work you put into it really paid off in the end. I'm sure they feel the same way too. Nice work, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, it's time for an after party!
I mean, after a quick debrief!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought you didn't like doing those.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our show went super duper well today, including our new song, so I'm too excited not to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right now, I want to keep improving and give everyone better performances, so let's do a debrief before I forget that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, before we do... When is our next show supposed to be?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing's set in stone yet, but next month at the earliest...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll have to practice quite a bit, again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's true, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Starting next time, I'm thinking about having us sell tickets for our shows. Would that be okay with all of you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tickets?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we'd be gathering people to come see our show and selling tickets to them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Until now, the owner and manager have been giving us a free pass, but if we're serious about going pro, this is something we'll have to do eventually.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Finding ways to sell tickets alongside practicing won't be easy, but we can take it one step at a time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I've never done anything like this before, but I think we'll be fine as long as we work together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you're right. We can do this as long as we're together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll try calculating how much time we'll need to sell them and work that into our schedule.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad we got to talk about it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, you were right.
It's too much for one person to handle.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, my guess is that you'd do whatever it takes if we do ever find ourselves in a bind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: N-No, I wouldn't...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Just a joke.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But if that ever happens...
Please, ask me for help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...
